scenarios.name: normal_operation
scenarios.description: 正常 Backup 操作场景：创建备份保管库 → 启用备份 → 列出恢复点 → 删除
commands: az backup vault create --name test-backup-vault --resource-group test-rg --location eastus
az backup item set --vault-name test-backup-vault --resource-group test-rg --container-name test-vm --item-name test-vm --policy-name DefaultPolicy
az backup recoverypoint list --vault-name test-backup-vault --resource-group test-rg --container-name test-vm --item-name test-vm
az backup vault delete --name test-backup-vault --resource-group test-rg --yes

scenarios.name: partial_failure
scenarios.description: 部分失败场景：备份保管库创建成功但恢复点列表失败
commands: az backup vault create --name fail-backup-vault --resource-group test-rg --location eastus
az backup recoverypoint list --vault-name fail-backup-vault --resource-group test-rg --container-name test-vm --item-name test-vm

scenarios.name: full_failure
scenarios.description: 完全失败场景：备份保管库不存在
commands: az backup vault show --name nonexistent-backup-vault --resource-group test-rg
